setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group using SLURM or local mode with a config dictionary
get_init_method_tcp_or_file: get a TCP or file-based initialization method string for a distributed job with world size and rank
all_reduce_tensor_with_average: all_reduce a tensor across all processes with optional averaging and device placement
gather_objects_to_master: gather pickleable objects from all ranks into a list on the master process
cleanup_distributed_and_ray: cleanup the distributed process group, Ray, and GP utilities and release OS ports
